Elaine B.: Heads-up — Borealis reported a customer-facing regression: p50 up to ~2s and p99 to ~12s on Dedicated pool-dedicated-7. They want a mitigation window now, and an engineering commitment for a short-term workaround. Who can own?
Maria S.: tagging @Jordan H. @Sam K. — any recent changes that could explain tail?
Jordan H.: I saw spike correlating with a canary change to batching heuristics (v3.4.2) around 21:25 UTC. When seq_len > 1024 our continuous-batching kicks in and increases latency under certain queue conditions. Hypothesis: batching threshold miscalculation + a rare KV cache miss.
Sam K.: I can revert the canary to previous batching behavior. Need quick approval to roll back canary on pool-dedicated-7. ETA ~25–30m for rollback + verification.
Alex P.: I'll take customer comms. Planning to offer a 1-hour workaround window starting 23:00 UTC. Also propose routing back to the rax-small model variant as fallback if rollback doesn't clear it.
Elaine B.: @Sam K. please proceed if rollback is safe. Confirm if we need DB/infra assistance.
Sam K.: no infra changes needed, just runtime config flip. Starting rollback now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated by Sam K. — rollout id: rb-2026-11 — start_ts: 4367891500
Jordan H.: while rollback runs, quick runbook: 1) monitor p99 on pool-dedicated-7, 2) scale up small-model variant if traffic spikes, 3) capture KV cache hit rates. I can add a short metric dashboard.
Maria S.: cross-team ask: eng-oncall, please keep this thread as the single source of truth for owner handoffs and timelines. Eng-ML, confirm small-model compatibility for request routing.
Jordan H.: owners: Jordan H. (eng-platform - triage & metrics), Sam K. (eng-runtime - rollback), Maria S. (eng-ml - variant compatibility), Alex P. (CS - customer comms), Elaine B. (product - customer priorities).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed by Sam K. — success — end_ts: 4367891800
Sam K.: rollback succeeded, latency trending back toward baseline. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
Elaine B.: thanks all. Alex, ping when customer notified and accepted the workaround. Please add timeline and postmortem owner in this thread.
Alex P.: Customer notified and accepted the temporary window. Will post a short timeline + link to postmortem doc in the morning. Adding a follow-up: we should schedule an RCA with eng-platform + eng-ml to validate batching thresholds and add an automated alert for unusual seq_len distributions. :white_check_mark:
